newsitem.title: USA: Venturian Napco unit gets contract.
newsitem.headline: Venturian Napco unit gets contract.

text.p: Venturian Corp said its Napco International Inc subsidiary received an $8.2 million contract from an unnamed foreign government for repowering kits for M41 light tanks.
The kits provide new diesel engines and related components to replace the original gasoline engine for the vehicle that is no longer in production.
The award of the contract increased Napco's backlog to approximately $32 million, up from approximately $16 million at the start of the year, Gary appaport, Venturian president, said in a statement.
He said shipments, which are contingent upon an export license from the U.S. Department of State, are expected to begin in the first quarter and be completed by the third quarter.
Napco manufactures and supplies a variety of defense-related products. Venturian's other subsidiary is Venturian Software Inc.
